Job Title: ERP Business Analyst (0 to 2 yrs)
Company: SISKH Co., Ltd.
Location: null null
Employment Type: Full Time
Job Level: Entry Level
Salary: Negotiable

Job Description & Responsibilities:
Step into the role of an ERP Business Analyst and help transform how businesses work.
You don’t need a computer science degree to make a real impact — just a passion for bridging the gap between business goals and IT solutions.
You’ll have the opportunity to contribute to local and international ERP projects, working with platforms like Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central or custom-developed software solutions. With hands-on training and collaboration with cross-functional teams, you’ll grow into a Functional Consultant role and with experience, advance to become a Project Manager.
Ready to shape the future of digital transformation? Let’s build it together.
RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Gather information from stakeholders (e.g., business users and executives) to understand their needs, expectations and pain points
• Assist in identifying areas for improvement in business processes or system enhancements, based on analyzed requirements and process evaluations
• Document and validate business requirements, process flows and proposed solutions
• Communicate with various stakeholders, including technical and non-technical audiences, to ensure alignment and understanding
• Design and configure process flows to meet the agreed requirements
• Draft and execute various testing scenarios to identify defects and ensure functionality
• Conduct user training
• Support User Acceptance Test
• Assist with execution of Go-live preparation activities
• Participate as key member of Post go-live support

Requirements & Qualifications:
• A curious mind
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
• Bachelor's degree in any discipline
• Proficient in Microsoft Office suite
• Excellent command of written and spoken English
• Ability to clearly articulate complex concepts
• Proactive team player with great people skills
• Organized and detail-oriented
• Ability to multi-task effectively
• Calm and solution-driven under pressure
Contact Information
application@siskh.com.kh
Please submit your application with the subject heading “I’m ready to start my consulting career!”
We regret that only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
